## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: persist the retained compaction selection (exact
   admitted policy/parameters + retained/omitted content + pair/batch/
   required-group joins) through the current owner
   (`hharness_context::compact` record → `context.compaction.completed`
   payload → the run's fenced writer), and replay the durable selection
   deterministically. Define the shared input representation the
   prepared call consumes (R5.19 leg).
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.18.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged. A new shared/persisted
   decision belongs in the owning ADR admission, not an
   implementation-local substitute.

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): persist exact admitted policy/parameters
    and retained/omitted content/pair/batch/required-group joins using
    current owners; replay prefix reproduces selection; shared input
    representation consumed by prepared call defined.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): unknown policy, duplicate IDs,
    protected-group eviction, orphan pair/batch, missing
    completion-age join, trigger absence/ineffectiveness and fallback
    keep explicit distinct results; no parallel context
    representation.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership/evidence): REQ-E-206 contributing slice
    mapped to R5.20 AC-3 predicate + aliases REQ-E-003/E-104 to
    numbered checks/evidence in coverage register; achieved D/E
    separate from owed R/P + actual-execution E; no full-target claim.
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): regression fails without;
    fmt --check + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode
    checks per touch; exact commands + counts; scratch stores.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal phase gate): green in scope; REQ ids
    stamped; owed legs as DEFERRALS rows w/ owner/trigger/control;
    ADRs for owned decisions; run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree;
    operating clauses met; no deferred predicate becomes MET by close.

## Plan

(provisional — Phase 1)

1. `hh-context` (the compact owner — I-02/CC1): new `retained` module —
   `RetainedSelection` (the persisted `selection` member of
   `context.compaction.completed`): `input` = the shared selection
   input representation (policy{variant_ref, parameters}, trigger,
   window_cap, needed, target_fraction_ppm, occupancy, legal cut
   points, flattened items with retention/source_seq/paired_with/
   batch_id/tool join) + `retained[]`/`omitted[]`/`status`/
   `pipeline_index`/`fallback_variant`; canonical `to_json` + strict
   `from_json` over `codec` helpers (integer-canonical, no floats).
2. `CompactionStrategy::selection_parameters()` (default `{}`;
   `ClearToolResults` emits `{capabilities, older_than,
   completed_invocations}` — the completion-age join the variant
   consumed); `compact()` mints `record.selection` at every
   `mint_record` site via `RetainedSelection::mint(input, view, …)`;
   `events::compaction_completed` emits additive `selection` member
   (durable/wire compatible — payload rows gain a member, no class or
   generated artifact changes).
3. `replay_selection(&RetainedSelection)` — rebuild `CompactInput`
   from the recorded representation, re-run `assess` + the recorded
   variant's `propose`/`execute` (the same production code path — no
   parallel selection logic), compare recomputed omitted/retained/
   outcome vs the record → `SelectionVerdict::Reproduced | Diverged |
   Refused(SelectionRefusal)` with the AC-2 distinct refusals
   (`UnknownPolicy`, `DuplicateIds`, `ProtectedGroup`, `OrphanPair`,
   `OrphanBatch`, `MissingCompletionAge`, `TriggerAbsent`,
   `UnknownItem`, `Malformed`) and distinct outcome kinds
   (`Untriggered`, `Applied`, `Ineffective`, `Failed`,
   `via_fallback`).
4. `crates/hh-context/tests/r5_18.rs` — battery per the test matrix;
   fails-without proven (selection member absent / replay type absent
   ⇒ compile-red at base).

| AC-1 | evict_oldest compaction → durable `selection` member present: policy ref + params, retained/omitted ids, pair/batch/required joins; `verify_selection` → `Reproduced{Applied}` |

| AC-2 | `hh/unknown@9` variant_ref → `UnknownPolicy` |
| AC-2 | duplicate context_item_id / candidate_id → `DuplicateIds` |
| AC-2 | required-retention item in omitted → `ProtectedGroup` |
| AC-2 | pair split (one side omitted) → `OrphanPair`; batch split → `OrphanBatch` |
| AC-2 | clear_tool_results: tool item missing `completed_invocations` entry → `MissingCompletionAge` |
| AC-2 | record lacking `trigger` member → `TriggerAbsent`; requirement-none record → `Untriggered` outcome |
| AC-2 | recomputed-free < min under hard → `Ineffective`/status mismatch → `Diverged`; `fallback_variant` carried → distinct `via_fallback` |
| AC-2 | tampered omitted set → `Diverged` (never silently reconciled) |
